series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 5 of 7

beats.vo: You don't need technique for your first time. You need one thing.
beats.image_prompt: A single standing wireframe figure in calm profile, facing one bright golden point of light floating at chest height. Minimal, still, nothing else in the frame.

beats.vo: This is number five of the seven things nobody tells you; follow for all of them, number one changes everything.
Five: the only real skill is paying attention. Watch her, notice what she responds to, do more of that.
beats.image_prompt: A single wireframe human ear in profile, with concentric golden sound ripples flowing in toward it from the edge of the frame. Nothing else.

beats.vo: That's the whole thing. Guys waste the entire time stuck in their own head, worrying about their performance.
beats.image_prompt: A single wireframe head in profile with the brain glowing gold, tangled looping golden lines knotted tightly inside it. Nothing else in the frame.

beats.vo: Get out of your head and put your attention on her instead.
beats.image_prompt: A single open wireframe hand held out palm up, a small softly glowing golden heart hovering just above the palm. Calm, minimal, nothing else.

beats.vo: Number four is the one nobody thinks about — and it prevents most of the disasters.
beats.image_prompt: Two simple empty speech-bubble outlines, slightly overlapping, drawn in glowing amber wireframe line. No text inside the bubbles. Nothing else.
